purpose: Local, unpublished CloudWatch Agent security-rebuild candidate

new_import_bootstrap_pin.reason: The JMX backport introduces this import before closure discovery. Pin it before go-list to avoid resolving the latest version transiently; the official full-core map verifies the final selection.

module_updates.candidate_rationale: GHSA-wg65-39gg-5wfj names Prometheus v3.5.3 LTS (Go module v0.305.3) as fixed. This candidate keeps the Amazon receiver's AppendHistogramCTZeroSample interface and pairs the known Prometheus API changes with the official OTel v0.128/v1.34 core cohort.

otel_core_cohort.selection: The Dockerfile derives the production-reachable go.opentelemetry.io/collector/* intersection from the three agent main packages, emits exact go get targets from this checked map, then rejects any final reachable core module that is unmapped or at a different version.

module_updates.otel_core_cohort_source: The full official collector v0.128 module-set map replaces the prior partial six-module proposal. The Amazon Prometheus receiver package and focused JMX/resolver regressions now compile and pass; complete Agent compilation still fails in translator API consumers. This is not full compatibility or runtime proof.

legacy_expandconverter.purpose: Archived compatibility module retained outside the official v0.128 map to preserve existing bare-dollar, braced-dollar, and double-escape configuration behavior.
legacy_expandconverter.risk: It imports a confmap internal package and is deprecated upstream. The lock is not an SCA waiver; the build validates the exact archive bytes and is configured to run resolver-chain regressions before compilation.

module_updates.v0_305_3_attempt_outcome: Production dependency resolution and the hash-locked MetricFamily patch passed, but make build-for-docker-amd64 produced OTel/API compiler errors. The diagnostic build was intentionally canceled after those errors; no candidate image or passing scan exists.
module_updates.resolution_note: The prior attempt selected x/net v0.57.0 and x/text v0.41.0 because x/crypto v0.56.0 requires them; the scan-proposed x/net v0.56.0 and x/text v0.39.0 cannot coexist with it. The v0.305.3 attempt resolved and compiled far enough to expose the recorded API errors, but it did not produce a candidate image.

reviewed_patch.scope: Six scrape.MetricMetadata literals and three created-series comparisons change Metric to MetricFamily. initTransaction passes an empty labels.Builder to the required DiscoveredLabels API without shadowing the labels package. The target allocator preserves its existing false-native-histogram behavior by assigning a true bool pointer. All other receiver code remains unchanged.
reviewed_patch.validation: A networkless linux/amd64 run of local/cloudwatch-agent-tools:verified (derived from the verified Go builder and containing GNU patch 2.8) applied this exact patch with --batch --fuzz=0 to the checksum-bound receiver fixture. A deliberately modified transaction preimage was rejected at hunk 1. This is patch validation only, not a production compile.

reviewed_jmx_patch.scope: Initializes the OTel v0.128 optional gRPC protocol before setting the existing JMX endpoint and removes the old nil HTTP assignment. HTTP stays absent/disabled; the JMX receiver remains enabled.
reviewed_jmx_patch.validation: Root GNU patch positive and tampered-preimage negative checks passed. Build nd1nlh1xogb70e0il2txavcqa executed TestConfigOptionalGRPCPreservesJMXEndpointAndDisablesHTTP successfully (package0.072s). This verifies optional helper/default-config semantics, not complete JMX receiver operation. The subsequent resolver package compile failed in Prometheus targetallocator.

reviewed_tls_field_patch.scope: All18 production TLSSetting references in targetallocator config and manager become TLS, matching confighttp0.128 ClientConfig. TLS input mappings and fork CA/cert/key file watchers remain intact.
reviewed_tls_field_patch.validation: Root networkless GNU2.8 fixture passed original apply, exact18 substitutions, watcher preservation and altered-config rejection. Build hyjzoku2mxcdl69w3cijfozzw compiled the targetallocator production package before the succeeding JMX test. No TLS runtime or full-image proof is claimed.

reviewed_new_api_patch.scope: Use api_v1.PrometheusVersion and pass ConvertOTLPDelta, NativeOTLPDeltaIngestion and CTZeroIngestionEnabled after EnableOTLPWriteReceiver, matching Prometheus0.305.3 canonical caller. Options are not enabled by this patch; LocalStorage remains the compatible TSDBAdminStats interface.
reviewed_new_api_patch.validation: GNU2.8 positive and altered-preimage-negative fixtures passed. Current fork Options leaves write receivers disabled with nil Appendable; any future enabling needs a real Appendable. No runtime or full-image proof yet.

compiler_cache.scope: Local locked compiler cache only; patched modules are deliberately not persisted. Final runtime and build-metadata copies exclude this cache. No remote cache publication.
